subject: Story capture: Meridian Health — 30-min discovery & recording consent
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Rao <pri.rao@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Story capture: Meridian Health — 30-min discovery & recording consent

Hi Priyanka,

Thanks again for agreeing to share Meridian's experience with Redwood. We try to keep these discovery calls tight — 30 minutes to cover outcomes, workflow, and results — and record for internal notes and a short customer story.

Proposed 30-min slots (PDT):
- Wed Mar 24, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Mar 24, 14:00–14:30
- Thu Mar 25, 09:00–09:30

Draft agenda (can trim):
1) Introductions & roles (5 min)
2) What problem Meridian solved with Redwood (8 min)
3) Deployment & workflow highlights (7 min)
4) Results / metrics + quote capture (7 min)
3) Next steps / approvals for publish (3 min)

Do any of the slots work? Also a few quick asks so we can prepare:
- Who should join from Meridian (names + titles)?
- Are there any compliance/PHI constraints we should be aware of for the recording?
- Do you prefer we share a short release/consent for signatures afterwards?

Attaching a short prep sheet that explains topics we typically cover. If you’d like legal looped in upfront, happy to include them on the thread.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
(415) 555-0187

Attachments: case-study-prep-sheet.docx

Hi Naomi,

Thanks — we'd be happy to participate. Wed Mar 24 14:00–14:30 PDT works for Tom and me. Adding Tom (PM) and legal to the thread.

Quick notes from our side:
- Attending: Priyanka Rao (Director, Care Ops), Tom Ellis (Product Manager).
- We will need to run the recording and any published quotes by our legal team.
- I'd prefer we review a release form after the call — legal prefers DocuSign for approvals. I'll also attach the standard NDA we use if you want a copy for your records.

See you Wednesday.

Best,

Subject: Re: Story capture: Meridian Health — 30-min discovery & recording consent

Hi Priyanka (and Tom),

Great — Wed Mar 24, 14:00–14:30 PDT is confirmed on our side. I sent a calendar invite separately. Agenda below (finalized):
• 14:00–14:05 — intros (Naomi, Priyanka, Tom, Aditya)
• 14:05–14:13 — problem + decision criteria
• 14:13–14:20 — deployment & ops highlights
• 14:20–14:27 — results/impact + any metrics you can share
• 14:27–14:30 — publish/approval steps and next actions

Per legal: we will record the session for internal note-taking and to create a short transcript to help capture quotes. We will not publish anything without your written release. I'll send a DocuSign release after the call that includes a redaction option and a review step for you/your legal team.

For your convenience, here's the release template we typically use: https://app.docusign.com/releases/RC-983274
And the prep folder with questions: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-meridian-case-study

If either of you would like to remove specific operational data (PHI or patient-identifiable info) from the transcript before it leaves Meridian, just flag it during the call and we'll redact. If legal wants to pre-review the release, we can wait to send the DocuSign until they confirm.

Appreciate you looping legal — I added Jasmine from our Legal Ops to help coordinate signatures.

Best,
Naomi
Customer Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — confirmed for 14:00–14:30 PDT today. Quick logistics note:
- We'll record via Zoom. Recording will be used to generate a transcript; we will not publish anything without your signed release (DocuSign link to follow tomorrow).
- Naomi will take notes; Aditya will capture technical details. Jasmine will coordinate the release with your legal team.
- If any PHI enters the conversation, please flag it immediately and we'll mark that segment for redaction.

Post-call plan: we send the transcript + a short draft pull-quote for approval, then the DocuSign release for signature. Expected turnaround to publish (once signed): ~7–10 business days.

Looking forward to the conversation.
